tools.name: search_clinics
tools.description: Search the public directory of Swedish MSK clinics (fysioterapi, naprapati, kiropraktik m.fl.) on fysio.care. Returns published clinics with FHIR Organization resources. Use list_clinic_services next to see what a clinic offers.

modality.description: Only clinics offering this treatment modality.

friskvard.description: Only clinics where friskvårdsbidrag can actually be spent.

tools.name: list_clinic_services
tools.description: List the bookable services of one clinic, with duration, price (SEK) and a FHIR HealthcareService per bookable variant. The variant id is what get_available_slots takes.

clinic_slug.description: The clinic slug from search_clinics (the URL segment, e.g. "mickes-klinik-lund").

tools.name: get_available_slots
tools.description: Free appointment slots for one bookable service variant at one clinic, up to 14 days ahead. Each slot carries a FHIR Slot resource and a bookingUrl where the PATIENT completes the booking themselves on the web (this server never books).

clinic_slug.description: The clinic slug from search_clinics (the URL segment, e.g. "mickes-klinik-lund").

service_variant_id.description: A bookable service variant id from list_clinic_services.

from_date.description: Window start (YYYY-MM-DD, clinic runs Europe/Stockholm). Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_next_available_date
tools.description: Earliest free slot for a service variant, scanning up to 90 days ahead. Use when get_available_slots comes back empty.

clinic_slug.description: The clinic slug from search_clinics (the URL segment, e.g. "mickes-klinik-lund").

service_variant_id.description: A bookable service variant id from list_clinic_services.
